Q6113.reason: Modern arson statutes reach reckless burning, and voluntary intoxication does not negate recklessness, so the forgotten stove can support guilt despite the common-law malice requirement.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are non-binding and act as material sources that can evidence or enunciate customary law, so B and C are wrong, though the team note says B or C.

Q9002.reason: The grantor's power to re-enter on breach, rather than automatic reversion, makes this a fee simple subject to a condition subsequent, though the team note says A or D.
